name: cable-palm-rotational-row.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the cable palm rotational row by attaching a single handle to the low pulley cable.
2. Adjust the stack to the desired weight.
3. Position yourself around 3 feet from the cable machine and grasp the handle with your right hand.
4. Take the weight off the stack and bend at the knees slightly.
5. Put your left hand on your left thigh for stability.
6. Starting with an overhand position, start pulling your arm towards your side.
7. As you're pulling the weight, twist at the wrist to form an underhand grip (palms facing up).
8. Pull your arm in as far as possible and squeeze through the shoulder blade.
9. Slowly lower the weight back down, twisting at the wrist back to the overhand position.
10. Repeat for reps and then repeat on the opposite arm.
